content.createNewProject:
[Open a folder](command:vscode.openFolder) that contains a .NET project or create a new project.
[Create New Project](command:dotrush.createNewProject)
description.workspaceProperties: Additional MSBuild properties to pass to the workspace (e.g. Configuration=Debug).
description.skipUnrecognizedProjects: Determines if unrecognized projects are skipped when projects are opened.
description.loadMetadataForReferencedPro: Determines if metadata from existing output assemblies is loaded instead of opening referenced projects.
description.showItemsFromUnimportedNames: Determines if items from unimported namespaces are shown in completion lists.
description.targetTypedCompletionFilter: Determines if target-typed completion is enabled.
description.alwaysShowCompletionList: Determines if the completion list is always shown when a trigger character is typed, even if Roslyn does not consider it a valid completion trigger.
description.restoreProjectsBeforeLoading: Determines if projects are restored before they are loaded.
description.compileProjectsAfterLoading: Determines if projects are compiled after they are loaded.
description.projectOrSolutionFiles: Paths to project or solution files to load.
description.compilerDiagnosticsScope: Show compiler errors and warnings for:
description.analyzerDiagnosticsScope: Show analyzer errors and warnings for:
description.applyWorkspaceChanges: Determines if changes made to the workspace are applied to the project files.
description.dotnetSdkDirectory: Path to the SDK directory to use for .NET projects (e.g. C:\Program Files\dotnet\sdk\9.0.201).
description.analyzerAssemblies: Paths to additional Roslyn analyzer assemblies (.dll files) to include during analysis.
description.diagnosticsFormat: Determines how diagnostics are presented in the editor.
description.dispatcherType: Determines the type of dispatcher used by the server.
description.projectAssembliesOnly: Use only project assemblies for debugging.
description.searchMicrosoftSymbolServer: Search Microsoft Symbol Server for missing PDBs.
description.searchNugetSymbolServer: Search Nuget.Org Symbol Server for missing PDBs.
description.automaticSourcelinkDownload: Automatically download source files from SourceLink.
description.console: Console to use for debugging console applications.
description.launchBrowser: Automatically open a browser when debugging ASP.NET applications.
description.noRestore: Determines if the project will be restored before building.
description.noDependencies: Determines if the project dependencies will be built.
description.additionalBuildArguments: Additional arguments to pass to the build command.
description.additionalEnvironment: Additional environment variables to pass to the build command.
description.preLaunchTask: Task to run before launching the test run.
description.runSettingsPath: Path to a .runsettings file to use when running tests.
